title: tanacetum roylei
intro: Tanacetum roylei, commonly known as Wild Chamomile, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Tanacetum roylei include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties.
